method: Official OpenAI documentation opened through web tool; no paid provider request, no API credential read, no model-list request performed.
accountAvailability: Not yet verified for the Hanami credential. Documentation lists these as available API models; project access, quota and organization-verification requirements require a real request.

findings.architecture: Single-image edit through the Images API; no mainline Responses model or AI SDK required.
findings.modelChoice: Sunburst is documented for editing precision, Flare for fast everyday image generation. Pin dated snapshots and compare actual outputs before selecting speed over precision.
findings.fileInput: Multipart JPEG, PNG or WebP under 50 MB supported by API; Hanami deliberately limits incoming prepared photo to 2 MiB and decoded pixels to 40 million.
findings.mask: PNG alpha mask, same dimensions as input, transparent pixels edited. Reference specifies under 4 MB; general guide mentions under 50 MB. Use the stricter 4 MB limit. Masking guides the model and is not pixel-exact.
findings.geometry: Custom output dimensions must be multiples of 16, ratio at most 3:1, 655360 through 8294400 pixels, maximum edge3840; above2560x1440 experimental. Engine reversibly upscales small inputs and pads, then restores original dimensions.
findings.preservation: Guarantee original normalized RGB pixels remain unchanged outside the confirmed mask using lossless PNG server recomposition. An incorrect user mask can still include protected objects; prompt alone is not a preservation guarantee.
findings.output: GPT Image returns base64 image data. JPEG is used for provider latency; final recomposed storage is lossless PNG.
findings.inputFidelity: Omit input_fidelity for 2.x models. It is an older1.x control, not a generic detail-preservation flag.
findings.retries: Official SDK defaults to two retries and ten-minute timeout. Engine uses one direct fetch attempt and240-second timeout. No Images idempotency guarantee was located in official reference; app must claim jobs atomically and avoid automatic retries after ambiguous outcomes.
findings.usage: Record provider request ID, full usage, provider/model/prompt version/quality/size. Compute estimate from text/image input and image output tokens when provided. GPT Image2 calculator does not predict2.5 token consumption.
findings.commercial: OpenAI Services Agreement allows API integration into customer applications and assigns output rights subject to law and terms. Consumer ChatGPT subscriptions do not establish API access or credit.
findings.data: Images API inputs are not used for training by default. Default abuse-monitoring retention is30days; no application-state retention. Do not claim EU residency or Zero Data Retention unless account configuration is verified.
findings.deprecated: GPT Image1 was shut down on2026-10-23. Do not start this integration on gpt-image-1, DALL-E2 or DALL-E3.

priceCaveat: Estimated standard rate excluding tax and negotiated discounts. Direct Images edit requests do not receive the documented Responses-only input-cache discount.
